direct_catalog_recheck.edition_scope: Differences in physical format, casing and cataloged impression are grounds for independent-copy collation, not proof of different printing blocks or textual variants. 1827 Dōkō preface appears in 1869 revised catalog; inherited preface does not prove identical impressions.
